journal_lines: High ground gives everything away. The hunter spotted the quarry. The miner spotted the vein. Both worth the climb.
Ridge with a view of the valley and the stone. Took what we came for and more.
Lookout point. Used it well. The mountain gives back when you get above it.
From up here you can see where the ore runs and where the animals water. Useful.
Spent an hour at the lookout. The mountain spoke. The mountain often does, from this height.
Wind at the ridge cold enough to teach the ears something. Stayed anyway, the view earned it.
Saw three herds and one seam from the same spot. Counted both as work.
Climbed for the seam, stayed for the view, went home with both.
